records.title: Implicit Neural Representations for Image Compression
records.reason: The arXiv abstract studies INRs as an image-compression pipeline with quantization, entropy coding, and faster per-image fitting; these compression mechanisms are adjacent to model compression, but the measured target is image coding rather than LLM inference.

records.title: An Empirical Study of the Impact of Hyperparameter Tuning and Model Optimization on the Performance Properties of Deep Neural Networks
records.reason: The paper concerns how tuning and model-optimization choices change DNN performance properties, including deployment latency and model size; its empirical scope is general DNNs rather than LLM serving, so transfer to the target system remains uncertain. Primary-source retrieval failure: ACM DL primary DOI page returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; no primary abstract was retrieved from that page.

records.title: Degree-Quant: Quantization-Aware Training for Graph Neural Networks
records.reason: Degree-Quant trains quantized graph neural networks for low-precision inference and reports CPU speedups from INT8 arithmetic, making inference quantization and runtime efficiency its explicit subject.

records.title: Methods for Pruning Deep Neural Networks
records.reason: This survey reviews deep-network pruning methods as a route to reducing model redundancy and resource demands; the abstract presents pruning as model compression, a transferable efficiency mechanism for inference models.

records.title: Overcoming Oscillations in Quantization-Aware Training
records.reason: The abstract links low-bit quantization-aware training to inference accuracy in efficient networks and proposes oscillation-dampening/freezing methods to preserve 3–4-bit model quality, directly supporting quantized deployment.

records.title: On-Device Machine Learning: An Algorithms and Learning Theory Perspective
records.reason: Although the survey frames on-device ML as resource-constrained, its stated subject is on-device training, online learning, and model adaptation; it does not address efficient inference or an inference execution system.

records.title: Explainable Generative AI (GenXAI): a survey, conceptualization, and research agenda
records.reason: The survey organizes explainability needs and methods for generative AI; the abstract mentions cost as one explanation desideratum but does not study inference-system cost reduction or execution efficiency.

records.title: HiNeRV: Video Compression with Hierarchical Encoding-based Neural Representation
records.reason: HiNeRV combines neural video compression with pruning and quantization, but its target is rate-distortion performance of a video codec; the abstract does not connect its compression pipeline to LLM inference systems.

records.title: Rethinking On-Policy Self-Distillation for Thinking Models
records.reason: The paper studies how privileged self-distillation affects thinking-model accuracy and correction behavior during training; its abstract reports degradation rather than an inference-efficiency mechanism.

records.title: Modelling drug-induced cellular perturbation responses with a biologically informed dual-branch transformer
records.reason: The publisher abstract describes XPert, a dual-branch transformer for predicting drug-induced cellular gene-expression changes and dose–time responses; its purpose is biological prediction, not inference-system efficiency.

records.title: VulnLLM-R: Specialized Reasoning LLM with Agent Scaffold for Vulnerability Detection
records.reason: VulnLLM-R adds a specialized reasoning model and agent scaffold for vulnerability detection; the abstract focuses on security-detection performance and does not identify serving, latency, or compute-efficiency contributions.

records.title: Listen, Pause, and Reason: Toward Perception-Grounded Hybrid Reasoning for Audio Understanding
records.reason: The abstract presents a perception-grounded hybrid reasoning model for audio understanding; it focuses on audio task reasoning and perception quality without a concrete inference-efficiency or runtime contribution.

records.title: Breaking the Barriers of Molecular Dynamics With Deep‐Learning: Opportunities, Pitfalls, and How to Navigate Them
records.reason: This review concerns using deep learning to address accuracy, speed, and sampling limits in molecular-dynamics simulations; its computational target is scientific simulation, not LLM inference or model-serving infrastructure.

records.title: TensorLens: End-to-End Transformer Analysis via High-Order Attention Tensors
records.reason: TensorLens is an analysis method for interpreting transformer attention tensors; the abstract emphasizes model analysis and explanations, not reduced inference cost or a more efficient execution path.

records.title: Generative Modeling of Molecular Dynamics Trajectories
records.reason: The paper uses generative models as surrogate models for molecular-dynamics trajectories and related scientific tasks; it targets molecular simulation rather than LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) Models and Generative Algorithms Represent a New Paradigm for Genomics Research
records.reason: The registered title identifies a broad genomics review, but the MDPI primary article page could not be retrieved, so its abstract-based relevance could not be established. records.title: Learning transcriptome architecture from sequence with a long-context RNA foundation model

records.title: Demystifying LLM-as-a-Judge: Analytically Tractable Model for Inference-Time Scaling
records.reason: The paper explicitly analyzes inference-time scaling for LLM-as-a-judge systems; this connects allocation of additional inference compute to judge behavior and is a direct inference-time resource-scaling topic.

records.title: SGI: Structured 2D Gaussians for Efficient and Compact Large Image Representation
records.reason: SGI compresses structured 2D Gaussian image representations and speeds their fitting; its abstract concerns image representation and reconstruction, not LLM model compression or serving.

records.title: On the Optimal Reasoning Length for RL-Trained Language Models
records.reason: The paper directly studies how reasoning length relates to accuracy in RL-trained language models at inference time, making reasoning-token allocation and test-time compute the central subject.
